name: Collin County, Texas (United States)
description: Light blue field charged with the county logo: the Texas flag arranged as a stylised letter C, with the star on the blue and the white and red halves at the fly.
history: Collin County is a county in the northern part of Texas. The flag was adopted on 11 September 1978 (the logo designed by Steve Jarvis of Jarvis Putty Jarvis for the new county government centre was adopted for the flag by the Commissioners' Court on 11 September 1978, according to Flags of the World).
